head.h1: Private Chef & Catering in JLT — Menus, Prices and What's Included

opening_paragraph: A private chef in JLT costs from AED 700 per person, and myCHEF sends a vetted chef who plans the menu, cooks and serves every course. That brings restaurant-quality dining to your apartment, with no need to book a table two towers over or fight for parking on a Friday night.

MyCHEF brings you a chef, sets the menu around your occasion, and runs the whole evening — cooking, service and cleanup — inside the Jumeirah Lake Towers cluster you already call home. Most guests here are residents and professionals in the lakeside high-rises beside Dubai Marina, and during our published business hours you will usually hear back promptly with a chef match and an itemised proposal.

Browse sample menus for a starting point or describe the evening you have in mind and the chef designs around it. Because ingredients are bought fresh for your date, seasonal produce and market fish shape the final dishes instead of a rigid catalogue.

add_block.new_heading: What does a private chef in JLT include?
new_paragraphs: A private chef JLT booking is fully hands-off for you: menu design, the chef on site, service staff where needed, plating and full cleanup are all part of one price. You confirm the date, guest count and cluster; the chef confirms the dishes, shops for fresh ingredients, arrives with the equipment your apartment kitchen lacks, and leaves the space as clean as it was found. This is the difference between catering JLT that drops off trays and a personal chef who cooks in front of you. For a quiet dinner for two or a table of twelve, the private dining JLT format is the same — a professional kitchen brought to your counter, minus the noise, the queue and the drive home afterwards. Nothing on the night is your job except deciding who sits where.

add_block.new_heading: Private chef JLT for dinner parties, celebrations and corporate events
new_paragraphs: JLT bookings lean toward three occasions, and each is handled by the same core service. Apartment and villa dining tops the list — an intimate dinner party where a home chef plates each course while you stay at the table. Next come small celebrations: birthdays, anniversaries and engagements where JLT party catering turns a living room into the venue. Third is work — corporate team dinners and after-hours JLT event catering for the offices packed into the cluster towers. Whether it is villa catering for a family gathering or a canapé-and-cocktail reception, the chef and menu are built around your guest list instead of a fixed package. Group size sets the format: seated and plated for a dozen, or grazing stations and finger food for a livelier crowd. Tell us the occasion and the chef adapts course count, pacing and presentation to match.

add_block.new_heading: How does private dining work in a JLT tower?
new_paragraphs: JLT's cluster layout and shared service lifts mean logistics matter, so we sort them before the day. When you book, we confirm the tower, cluster letter and loading or service-lift access up front, which is how an in-villa chef arrives, sets up and plates on time in a high-rise instead of getting stuck at a security desk. Most JLT kitchens are apartment-sized, so the chef plans equipment and prep to suit the space — compact stations, quiet cooking and tidy handling of a small galley kitchen. Parking and guest access are confirmed too, so your arrivals are not left circling the podium. It is the practical groundwork that keeps a lakeside apartment dinner feeling effortless: you and your guests notice the food, not the operation behind it.

new_paragraphs: Booking is three steps and usually settles inside a business day. First, share your date, guest count and JLT address; second, we match a vetted chef suited to your cuisine and occasion and send an itemised proposal; third, you confirm and we lock the menu with the chef ahead of the day. To hire a chef in JLT you do not need to know the menu in advance — many guests start with just an occasion and a budget, and the chef shapes the rest. On the night, the chef and any service staff handle setup, cooking, service and cleanup, so a chef for hire in JLT leaves you free to host. Change of numbers or a late dietary note is fine; just tell us before the shop.

add_block.new_heading: Can you book a chef in JLT regularly, or full time?
new_paragraphs: Yes, and the pricing changes when you do. A one-off dinner is priced per person; a standing arrangement is not. Weekly meal prep in JLT starts from AED 1,898 a week for the Lite plan and AED 2,698 for Standard, with the chef cooking and portioning a week of meals in your apartment kitchen. A full time private chef in Dubai — one chef running the household kitchen daily — is quoted per placement instead of per head, because the figure depends on meals per day, household size and days worked. Both are set out on the weekly meal prep and full-time private chef pages, and either can start with a single JLT dinner to see how the chef cooks.

new_paragraphs: How much does a private chef cost in JLT?
Private dining in JLT starts from about AED 700–950 per person, depending on guest count, menu and service level. Larger groups come down per head, so send your numbers for an exact quote.
Which JLT clusters and towers do you cover?

All of JLT — every Jumeirah Lake Towers cluster around the lakes, the high-rise apartments and duplexes and the surrounding streets — plus nearby Dubai communities. Confirm your exact address when you enquire.
What is included in a private chef JLT booking?
Everything from menu planning to the chef, the service staff, the plating and the cleanup — one team covers all of it, so hosting is the only thing left to you.
Can you cook halal, vegetarian or allergen-aware menus in JLT?

Yes. Every menu can be built fully halal, vegetarian or vegan. Gluten-free, nut-conscious and other dietary menu options may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed for the booking. Guests with allergies must provide full details before confirming their event.
How far ahead should I book a chef for hire in JLT?

Book as early as you can: 48 hours of notice suits a standard apartment dinner and 5 to 7 days a bespoke menu or a larger party. Weekends and peak dates fill sooner. Short-notice requests are assessed individually.
Do you cater JLT parties and corporate dinners?
Yes — JLT party catering, small celebrations and corporate team dinners are among the most common bookings here, each scaled to your guest count and cluster.
Are there reviews for a private chef in JLT?
MyCHEF publishes client reviews only as events are delivered, so there is no rating here to lean on.
Can I book a private chef in JLT full time or every week?

Yes. Weekly meal prep starts from AED 1,898 a week for Lite and AED 2,698 for Standard. A full-time household placement is quoted per placement instead of per head, because it depends on meals per day, household size and days worked.
How do I book a home chef in JLT?
Share your date, guest count and address; we match a vetted chef and send an itemised proposal, usually within one business day.
For private chef jlt, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

add_block.new_heading: Why book myCHEF for private dining in JLT?
new_paragraphs: MyCHEF was founded by a chef trained in some of Europe's most demanding kitchens, on one idea: you own the evening, we carry the work. MyCHEF is implementing a structured partner verification standard across its chef network, covering identity, trade licensing and permitted activities, food-safety and food-handler records, and references ; some stages are in place and the rest are being rolled out as part of a continuing review. We are honest about it, too: no system removes every risk, so we match each event to the chef well suited to it. For a JLT dinner, that is often Ahmed Al-Rashid , whose 18+ years across Dubai, London and Paris in classical French technique show in the way he designs each menu as a collaboration with the host, every course timed, seasoned and served to exacting standards. We have delivered intimate villa dinners and large celebrations across Dubai's communities. Client reviews are added only as events are delivered — real feedback, not fabricated.

add_block.new_heading: How much does a private chef in JLT cost?
new_paragraphs: JLT private chef cost is priced per person and starts from AED 700. Intimate dinners for two sit nearer AED 950–1,300 per head because a full chef's evening is shared between fewer guests; six guests land around AED 750–1,000; and ten or more come from AED 700 per person as the fixed effort spreads further. The quote covers the chef, the cooking, the service and the cleanup — not just the food. Most JLT bookings usually land between AED 700 and 950 a head once the menu is settled, which is what it costs to have a private chef cook and serve a full evening. If what you want is the food instead of the chef, a drop-off or buffet format starts from AED 90 per person, with a minimum of 10 guests, 20 for a buffet, and a minimum order of AED 900. JLT catering services for larger parties and corporate events are quoted on the same per-head logic, scaled to numbers and menu. See the full breakdown on private chef prices in Dubai , or send your date and guest count for an exact figure. There is no charge to receive an itemised proposal.
